title: Refined Spacetime
text: Place a Spacetime Spell Core in the Large Alchemical Reaction Pool's catalyst floor. React 10 B of Dilute Spacetime with one Time Warp Point and one Space Warp Point to produce 1 B of Refined Spacetime. The catalyst is not consumed.

At base speed, both points are consumed at the start. Every ten seconds consumes 1 B of Dilute Spacetime and produces 100 mB of Refined Spacetime, finishing after 100 seconds. This fluid conversion requires the large pool; a Primitive Reaction Cauldron cannot perform it.

Refined Spacetime has denser, stronger flowing light, but cannot form infinite sources or provide unlimited extraction from Liquid Crystal Balls. An Enhanced Alchemical Energy Core can catalyze 1 B into one Time Microcore and one Space Microcore together.
